newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka diesel, jet tender awarded to BB Energy.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka diesel, jet tender awarded to BB Energy.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender 160,000 barrels of gas oil and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel from BB Energy for December 19-20 delivery, a CPC source said on Friday.
The 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and jet A-1 were both purchased at a premium of $0.98 per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, on a cost-and-freight basis to Colombo.
The tender closed on November 27 and were valid until November 28.

In its last tender, which was awarded to Dutch trader Vitol, Sri Lanka bought 120,000 barrels of gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel at a premium of 67.5 cents and 47.5 cents, respectively, both over Singapore spot quotes on a c-and-f basis for December 12-13 delivery.
